submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best simulated resolution (2.9% FWHM at 662 keV), but its intrinsic background of 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day (Q1 2026 HPGe assay) is 4x the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, and that background comes from the crystal itself, so external shielding cannot fix it. This fails the low-background constraint. Of the two crystals that meet the budget, Crystal-K1 (0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day) has much better resolution (4.5%) than Crystal-K2 (8.5%), so K1 gives the best resolution that is actually allowed. Thickness: 5 cm, the nominal value used in the 2025 simulation. That simulation found resolution depends only weakly on thickness between 3 and 8 cm. The 4.5% figure is from that 2025 study; I did not run a new simulation. The DAQ needs no changes for K1, and the shielding is complete.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
